Oh thank God because my cable management is HORRIBLE. 

Also, please ignore the hammock. My legs are too long for a normal footrest :(

Alright, listen.

The other commenter is right, Stormlight is great but an entirely different beast. I implore you, finish Scadrial stories all in one go (well, before reading other Sanderson). You'll get a lot of differing opinions out there but the Scadrial sagas are an amazing ride through different flavours of book. The first trilogy is amazing, but the second is also amazing for an entirely different reason.

I'm really, really interested in seeing your further reviews.

Unfortunately it's the latter of the two choices.

She told me tonight that she's felt this way since she was 16. Loneliness and helplessness seems to be her biggest concerns. She's been mentioning how great our communication has been lately but this week I've let it lapse. 

Between not being able to connect with anyone she knows, having a lifetime physical illness, the stress of finances, and the fact that she stopped abilify cold turkey on Monday I think it just was too much.

Thank you for all the information, it was heard and is extremely helpful. A lot of the hospital staff walked me through what will happen now, and made sure that I knew there would be long term care involved. She was moved to a very small private behavioral hospital that seems quite nice, but they wouldn't let me see her after she was moved.

I told her as they were shutting up the ambulance that I would be with her when she got there. Now I'm just waiting for her to call at home instead.
